snippet.title: Beyond The Dark - Nightwatch | Reveal Trailer (US)
snippet.description:
You wake up in a house you’ve never seen before. A strange entity lurks in the hallways.
But you’re not alone. Face your fears together in this cooperative game that puts your nerves to the test! Who will dare to explore the house, while the other player guides them via the video surveillance system? Teaming up is your only hope of escaping. Will you hold out together until the end?
